annotations.title: Send a message to a user

description: Sends one end user a message from the developer to their in-app inbox, live or on their next visit; needs the inbox module. Never emailed, not even to `contact: true` senders: write to them from your own mail. Many users at once: neblla_broadcast. More: neblla_get_llms tools/send_communication

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

data.description: JSON payload for the app to render.

dateFrom.description: Start of a proposed appointment, ISO 8601.

dateTo.description: End of the proposed appointment, ISO 8601.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

thread.description: The commId of the message this one answers.

userId.description: The user's `userId` from neblla_list_communications, or `_id` from neblla_list_users.

name: neblla_send_communication
